spec.name: Halloween Cubic Carving Pumpkin
spec.description: An uncarved, solid pumpkin cube for Orange SMP Halloween voxel carving. Exactly one filled, axis-aligned cuboid with sharp corners; all rind, flesh and stem-scar details are painted flush onto its six faces.

prompt: A solid cubic pumpkin carving blank. STRICT geometry: exactly one axis-aligned cuboid from [0,0,0] to [16,16,16]. Completely filled cube, flat square faces and sharp corners, no stem geometry, no rounded corners, no bevel, no inset or protruding parts. Express pumpkin character only in generated pixel textures: warm orange rind with irregular dark vertical grooves on four sides, lighter fibrous orange flesh on top and bottom, a small painted green-brown stem scar flush on the top face. Uncarved, no face. The entire filled cube is later divided into removable carving voxels. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
